tzaddik.m: A very righteous person, especially a Hassidic spiritual leader.

tzaddikim.m: More than one tzaddik. tzaddik: a very righteous person, especially a Hassidic spiritual leader.

tzarevna.m: Another spelling of tsarevna. tsarevna: the daughter of a tsar.

tzaritza.m: Another spelling of tsaritsa. tsaritsa: the wife or widow of a czar.

tzatziki.m: An appetizer made from yogurt, cucumber, garlic, olive oil and dill or mint.

tzatzikis.m: More than one tzatziki. tzatziki: an appetizer made from yogurt, cucumber, garlic, olive oil and dill or mint.

tzimmes.m: A stew of fruit or vegetables traditionally served on Rosh Hashanah.

tzitzis.m: Another spelling of tzitzit. tzitzit: the knotted fringes of the tallit.

tzitzit.m: The knotted fringes of the tallit.

tzuris.m: Another spelling of tsuris. tsuris: (Yiddish) aggravating trouble.
